title: Transpera process file (transpera-process/2)
description: A process for Transpera Flow, with the evidence behind it. Only the fields marked required have to be there; anything left out is filled in and marked to confirm on the canvas. Nothing company-wide is applied: the upload adds the process (as a draft), its sources and its first principles, and never changes people, clients, services or demand.

citation.description: One quote that backs a value.

source.description: The id of one of the file's sources.

quote.description: The words said, verbatim. Quote just the sentence that gives the number.

time.description: Where in the source: a time in the recording (00:14:05), a page, a cell.

value.description: The number they stated, in the units of the value it backs (hours; 0 to 1 for a share). Different values for one number are a conflict, shown for you to settle.

name.description: What the process is called, e.g. Enquiry to signed client.

kind.description: pipeline: how new leads become clients (default). servicing: a recurring process for existing clients.

description.description: A sentence on what the process covers.

entity_name.description: What flows through it, e.g. lead, task. Default: lead for a pipeline, item for a servicing process.

sources.description: The materials the file is built from. They are added to Sources and linked to this process. Evidence points at them by id.

id.description: A short unique id, e.g. interview-maya. Evidence uses it.

title.description: e.g. Interview with Maya Chen, 30 Sep.

kind.description: transcript (a conversation), sop (a written procedure), spreadsheet, data (an export), notes (any other document, or a drawn map), screenshot or other.

date.description: The day it is from, like 2026-09-30.

body.description: The text itself (optional; leave it out for a long one). When given, quotes are checked against it.

steps.description: Every step. Give each a short unique id that links refer to. Leave out any number nobody gave you: it is marked as missing, and never invented.

id.description: A short unique id, e.g. review. Links use it.

name.description: What the step is called on the map.

type.description: step: someone does work. decision: items branch. wait: items sit and wait. start and end: where items come in and finish.

role.description: The role that does it, e.g. Managing director. Roles the company doesn't have yet are matched in the preview; none are created.

person.description: A person to pin it to (only if they are already in the company; otherwise ignored).

hands_on_hours.description: Hours of hands-on work per item (average).

wait_hours.description: Hours an item waits at this step per item (average).

rework_rate.description: Share of items sent back to do again, from 0 to 1 (0.1 is one in ten).

x.description: Position on the map. Give x and y together, or leave both out to be laid out left to right.

hands_on_range.description: The lowest and highest hands-on time in hours. The typical value is the number beside it.

wait_range.description: The lowest and highest wait in hours. The typical value is the number beside it.

rework_to.description: The id of the step rework goes back to. Default: this step.

sla_hours.description: Target hours for one visit to the step.

waiting_now.description: Items sitting at the step right now.

evidence.description: Quotes by value: hands_on_hours, wait_hours, rework_rate, waiting_now, sla_hours. Every number that came from a source should have its quote.

assumed.description: Why a value is an assumption, by value: hands_on_hours, wait_hours, rework_rate, waiting_now, sla_hours.

hands_on_hours.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

wait_hours.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

rework_rate.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

waiting_now.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

sla_hours.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

links.description: How the steps connect, each from one step id to another.

probability.description: The share of items that take this branch, from 0 to 1. Branches out of a step add up to 1.

evidence.description: Quotes that back this, word for word, each from one of the file's sources.

assumed.description: Why the value is an assumption: nobody said it, so say where the guess comes from ("Typical for a proposal; Sam confirmed the order of magnitude").

groups.description: Optional boxes that gather steps on the map.

steps.description: Ids of the steps in the group (not start or end steps).
